text: Growing up in an Asian household, the only target in my life was to get into college. A prestigious college. The road was long, hard and frustrating. I was sad, broken, hopeless for so many years. My parents couldn't accept me for who I am. I didn't know what to do. I saw no hope in my future. I was depressed, soulless. I started to lose hope towards me ever heading to a decent school and fulfilling my parents' expectations. One day I came across this song by Joey. Depressed, hopeless, I swore I would be back one day when I achieve what I want. Fast forward 1 year later, I got accepted into the school which people around told me that I could never attend. I thank God for his blessing. And don't ever lose hope people.

author: @Kaizen671
text:
Back in 2017 I listened to this song literally hundreds of times, grinding every free hour of every day for years at that point, trying to find a way to escape my soul crushing corporate job. I moved half way around the world away from friends and family just to focus. I was so damn stressed out for years...self-doubt, tears, no one taking me seriously, financial worry everyday, loneliness, sleep-deprived, missing out on memories with loved ones back home... just exhausted.

Fast forward to mid 2019, I ended up getting laid off from that soul crushing corporate job (blessing in disguise). So I decided to go all in on my side hustle and just a few months later, the damn global pandemic happened. I was stressed AF. But I honestly didn't have it in me to slap on my happy face and start job interviewing again. I was maxing out all of my credit cards & emptied my savings. Throw in some health scares , deaths of loved ones, among other personal things, and I was at yet another low point in life. 

Fast forward to 2022, I have a growing business that generates way more income than my corporate job, I have the freedom to travel & work from anywhere in the world, earn money in my sleep on autopilot, in the best shape of my life, train muay thai & jiujitsu almost everyday, go on grand adventures, and spend quality time with family and a select group of friends. This year alone I've been to 8 countries and crossed off multiple items from my bucket list. I'm just so damn grateful. Goals can be a mirage because they constantly evolve as we do so. Sometimes we forget to pat ourselves on the back once in a while. I guess writing this right now is a bit of a pat on the back. Don't stop pursuing your dreams, but don't forget to cut yourself some slack along the way as it doesn't go exactly as planned -- it rarely does.

I'm at a place now where I'm ready to level up again... I still listen to this song on repeat - now envisioning even greater goals, and hope that I'll eventually come back to this comment thread to write about more blessings, trials, and tribulations that this song has pulled me through. Until then, GET AFTER IT.

Hoping everyone here all the blessings & success 💯

For example:

"He's acting like a fein for that new video game."
"She’s been a fein for that candy all day."
The term is usually used in a casual or playful way, but it can also have a more negative connotation when referring to someone with a serious addiction.

text: Happy 8th Anniversary to Havana. I can't believe it's been 8 years since this song was released. This will always take me back to 2016 - 2018. I was only 8 when this song came out back in August 2017. I remember when this song was all over the radio and was played EVERYWHERE. Time went by way too fast. This song will bring back memories of my family and me going on vacations when we went to San Diego, CA, and Destin, FL for the first and second time. This song was playing when the sun was setting when we were by the beach. We went to go get ice cream and walked along the boardwalk when it was night by the city. I miss those days. (This was in Destin, FL btw). Time went by so fast, I know this won't make any sense but in 2022, six years after this song was released, the family I went on so many vacations that year, In April we went to Outer Banks, NC and Norfolk, VA, in May, we went to Aruba, in June, we went to Barbados, and in July, we went to Orlando, FL, only just my mom and sister and me to go see my cousins and to go to Disney World, this song was playing during every trip and now in 2025, I'm getting nostalgia from 3 years ago and from 2016 - 2017. August 3, 2017 - August 3, 2025. 8 YEARS LATER!
